newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish authority approves Handelsbanken purchase.
newsitem.headline: Swedish authority approves Handelsbanken purchase.

text.p: Sweden's Finance Inspectorate on Wednesday said it approved commercial bank Handelsbanken's proposed purchase of mortgage bank Stadshypotek.
"The Finance Inspectorate board has today given permission to Svenska Handelsbanken to acquire all of the shares in Stadshypotek AB," the authority said in a statement.
The statement came after rival bidder insurer Skandia on Tuesday withdrew its proposal to merge with Stadshypotek that had been opposed by the government.
Handelsbanken last Thursday announced a 22.9 billion crown takeover bid for Stadshypotek which is 34 percent state-owned. The bid immediately received government approval.
The bank, which is Sweden's largest by assets, has said it expects to close its offer of 190 crowns per A-share by the end of February.
Stadshypotek shares were at 1120 GMT trading one crown higher at 187.5 crowns while Handelsbanken was up three at 193 crowns.
